messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall-jun — p99 latency spike detected for /v1/streaming/generate in eu-west-1. p99 jumped from ~220ms -> ~1.6s over last 5m (alert threshold 1.2s). Affected routes: chat-stream, realtime-embeddings. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/6323123456
oncall-jun: Ack — I'm on it. Starting quick triage: dashboards, kvcache, worker queues.
sre-lead: Heads up — we promoted a kv-cache param canary to 10% in eu-west ~20m ago. Could be related.
oncall-jun: Quick checklist (will split tasks): 1) verify pod readiness & restarts 2) check GPU/worker queue depth 3) kv cache hit/miss trend 4) model fallback/rollouts 5) customer impact
platform-eng: Quick telemetry: pods healthy, 0 restarts last hour, GPU util normal. But streaming-worker queue depth spiked x3. KV miss rate +15% in last 10m. Logs show more prefix misses.
emily: Support: seeing increased load for few large tenants, UI shows extended load but no 500s yet. Logged as SUP-443 and alerted account owners.
oncall-jun: Running targeted queries in datadog/grafana — dropping examples: ```query: p99(streaming.latency){region:eu-west,route:stream} by {route}``` will paste graphs in a sec.
kevin: Correlation looks like kvcache evictions rose during a small mem pressure bump on the cache nodes. Suggest temporary mitigations: a) route small percentage traffic to eu-central, b) enable fallback to v2-small for streaming route, c) bump cache TTL back to previous value.
sre-lead: Agree. Traffic shift is lowest-friction. We have route policy "latency-fallback" ready. Also prepare config rollback for the canary.
oncall-jun: Shifting 10% traffic to eu-central now (route policy latency-fallback, override priority). Will monitor p95/p99 and kv miss.
incident-bot: Action logged: traffic-shift executed by oncall-jun at +34s. Monitoring window started.
platform-eng: After shift: p99 dropped from ~1.6s -> ~900ms within 90s, then stabilized ~450ms after 3m. KV miss rate trending down. Queue depth reduced.
oncall-jun: Marking live mitigation: traffic shift + model fallback plan. Next actions: platform-eng to investigate kvcache canary config (who rolled it), SRE to prepare full rollback if trend reverses, support to continue customer comms.
pm-support: Notifying top 3 impacted customers with templated update. No escalations yet.
oncall-jun: Closing active paging — we remain in watch for 30m. If >15% requests above SLO for 15m, will open a postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
